                                                                                                                        Skills and custom commands
                                                                                                                        /adversarial-tdd  Verification method for stories with behavioral changes. A short contract before coding, tests
                                                                                                                        only where they protect real behavior (each names the bug it catches), one build and one targeted test run at the
                                                                                                                        end of the story, a separate critic for medium/high-risk stories, and after-the-fact checks on the rb box (RED on
                                                                                                                        the pre-fix commit for bug fixes, mutation on high-risk functions, CRAP). No RED → GREEN loop, no gate inside the
                                                                                                                        story. Language-independent. Do not use for documentation-only or mechanical changes.
                                                                                                                          /capture-meeting  Extract a meeting into the operational memory graph (people/meeting/decision nodes)
                                                                                                                        /context-management  Decide when to compact or clear context at a safe sub-task boundary, and continue the active
                                                                                                                        goal.
                                                                                                                        /imagegen  Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos,
                                                                                                                        illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a
                                                                                                                        brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a
                                                                                                                        bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing
                                                                                                                        SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in
                                                                                                                        HTML/CSS/canvas.
                                                                                                                        /openai-docs  Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting,
                                                                                                                        customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they
                                                                                                                        refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs,
                                                                                                                        Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that
                                                                                                                        merely mention Codex.
                                                                                                                        /research-lansweeper-with-quill  Research Lansweeper-wide code and organizational knowledge through Quill, including
                                                                                                                        cross-repository implementations, service ownership, dependencies, shared APIs, pipeline evidence, Confluence
                                                                                                                        context, and organization-wide patterns. Use when an answer depends on repositories or documentation outside the
                                                                                                                        active checkout, or for cross-repo gaps during substantial plan enrichment. Do not use for questions confined to one
                                                                                                                        available repository; use local rg and source reads instead.
                                                                                                                        /review-agent  Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable
                                                                                                                        finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom
                                                                                                                        review instructions.
                                                                                                                        /skill-creator  Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting
                                                                                                                        resources.
                                                                                                                        /skill-installer  Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a
                                                                                                                        user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including
                                                                                                                        private repos).
                                                                                                                        /test-janitor  Reduce a requested test suite in small batches while preserving distinct behavioral and regression
                                                                                                                        protection. Use for test deletion or consolidation audits, with persistent test-to-mutant evidence. Never change
                                                                                                                        production code; run mutations only on the authorized AWS box.
                                                                                                                        Aliases: /resume [ID], /continue [ID], /history QUERY
                                                                                                                        Unknown slash input is refused locally; add a leading space to send literal text.
                                                                                                                        Keys
                                                                                                                          Ctrl+B  Send the running exec to the background
                                                                                                                          Esc  Interrupt the running turn
                                                                                                                          Enter  While a turn is running, queue the line for the next safe boundary
                                                                                                                          Up  With an empty busy composer, withdraw the last queued line for editing
                                                                                                                          Ctrl+Enter  While a turn is running, send the line now: interrupt and deliver it first
                                                                                                                          Ctrl+S  Save the composer draft, or restore the last saved one
                                                                                                                          Ctrl+C  Cancel a running turn; idle, abandon the line; twice in a row, exit
                                                                                                                          Option+P  Choose the current model
                                                                                                                          Option+O  Show the last tool output or collapsed prompt
                                                                                                                          Option+R  Retry a waiting provider now
